outcome: Preconception indicators (e.g., smoking, folic acid supplement use, planned pregnancy, severe mental health, obesity)
cohort: The study included 255,177 pregnancies recorded in the Northern Ireland MATernity System (NIMATS) from 2011-2021.
finding: A high proportion of women had sub-optimal preconception indicators, with women living in the most deprived quintile demonstrating a higher prevalence of risk factors compared to those in the least deprived quintile.
